description: Roll out the new API stack to 100% of production traffic

_seeded_flaw.description: the rollback window is only opened after 50% of traffic has already shifted
_seeded_flaw.message: rollback window opens only after half the rollout steps; a failed early phase would have no rollback in place

_doc: Rollout scenario: the plan shifts 50% then 50% of traffic before opening the global rollback window, so a failure in the first shift cannot be undone. The unsafe_sequencing heuristic flags the ordering; revision 2 opens the window first.
